summary: Independent design review of the integrated successor. At review time the remote main ref matches the recorded base 220242b1, and the candidate has only its five initialization and specification files above that base. Comparison to the two pinned predecessor subjects confirms that the 28 core paths and five CI paths exactly match the 33 allowed implementation and regression paths. Approval provenance, hook binding, content-sensitive schema validation, shared interfaces, SDK read-only Git, PR provenance across renames, closure ancestry, mixed tasks and complete maintenance gates all retain observable normal and failure checks. The integrated PR self-routing acceptance, new native V1 evidence, new subject-bound review and exact-head CI cover the interaction of core and workflow. Publication is limited to the authorized repository, candidate branch and merge commit; older records and prior PRs stay independently attributable.
